newsitem.title: UK: Chubb shares seen higher on bid news.
newsitem.headline: Chubb shares seen higher on bid news.

text.p: Shares in security and fire protection group Chubb Security Plc were expected to open higher Friday following a recommended 1.3 billion stg offer from Williams Holdings.
The offer of two new Williams shares and 704.12 pence in cash for every three Chubb shares values the shares at 450 pence.
Williams shares fell 15-1/2 pence to 322-1/2 pence.
Shares in Chubb jumped 82 pence on Thursday to close at 420 pence after the company confirmed it was in talks which might lead to a bid.
Williams chairman Sir Nigel Rudd said that Chubb represented an unparalleled opportunity for achieving the group's ambition to establish the group as world leader in fire protection and security.
Williams forecast pre-tax profits for the year to December 31 of 243 million stg, up 11 percent and a dividend for the year of 15.05 pence.
Analysts gave the deal a cautious reception.
"The industrial logic is good but it doesn't do much for Williams' earnings or balance sheet. It's rather a full multiple," said one.
A meeting for analysts is to be held at 0930 GMT.
